\section{Ten aggressive hypotheses}

The hypotheses below are deliberately stronger than the proved package.  They
are useful only because each is paired with a mathematical signature and a
falsification route.

\begin{hypothesis}[Vacuum weight]
The optimal positive retained-state weight is a coarse approximation to the
vacuum boundary amplitude.  A Doob transform by this weight converts hostile
boundary histories into a contractive positive kernel.
\end{hypothesis}

\begin{hypothesis}[Physical Lyapunov exponent]
On a complete nonvacuum observable core, the mass scale is the negative
physical-length Lyapunov exponent of an OS-compatible representation
cocycle:
\begin{equation}
 m=-\limsup_{L\to\infty}\frac1L
 \log\left\|\mathcal R_L\big|_{\mathbf 1^\perp}\right\|.
\end{equation}
This becomes a Hamiltonian mass only after positivity, completeness, and
reconstruction are established.
\end{hypothesis}

\begin{hypothesis}[Polymer boundary law]
Although a one-star centered displacement has strictly positive spill, shared
cochain and Bianchi constraints allow coordinated polymer displacements whose
minimum external-curvature cost grows with \(|\partial P|\) rather than
\(|P|\).
\end{hypothesis}

\begin{hypothesis}[Graded topology]
The sufficient retained topological state is a graded cocycle containing
continuous curvature, a center-valued two-cocycle, an integer flux lift, and
the transition data needed for their composition.
\end{hypothesis}

\begin{hypothesis}[Free-energy rigidity]
The transferable local rigidity functional is a normalized free-energy or
conditional relative-entropy cost, not a bare action charge.  Its useful
feature is compatibility with data processing under coarse-graining.
\end{hypothesis}

\begin{hypothesis}[Representational curvature]
Gauge fixing, orientation, charting, integration, and blocking define paths
in a representation graph.  The failure of alternative paths to commute is a
quantitative curvature or holonomy defect whose accumulated norm must vanish
or remain summable.
\end{hypothesis}

\begin{hypothesis}[Atlas-relative locality]
No single coordinate presentation must simultaneously expose gauge
invariance, microscopic realizability, positivity, and useful locality.
Physical locality is a gluing property of overlapping covariant charts and
regional observable systems.
\end{hypothesis}

\begin{hypothesis}[Counterexamples as completeness detectors]
A hostile conditioning counterexample diagnoses information erased from the
retained state.  Iterative state refinement should terminate when the induced
kernel becomes conditionally sufficient, or else demonstrate that the
proposed finite state description is inadequate.
\end{hypothesis}

\begin{hypothesis}[Mass without a confinement premise]
A mass gap can in principle be obtained from temporal rigidity of a complete
local gauge-invariant observable algebra without assuming a Wilson-loop area
law.  Observable density and reflection positivity remain indispensable.
\end{hypothesis}

\begin{hypothesis}[Observable-selective recovery]
Renormalization can be irreversible on microscopic coordinates while
admitting exact or approximate recovery on the physical observable algebra.
This gives an information-theoretic meaning to controlled forgetting without
pretending that coarse-graining is invertible.
\end{hypothesis}
